scope: First max_chars characters of each local FineWeb preview. List/bracket/literal-copy/natural-style eligible edits were applied jointly and the document checker passed. Nonce eligibility is counted, but nonce edits were off because they require a separate code pool. These are mechanical opportunities, not semantic rule prevalence or model competence. The multi-opportunity form panel uses greedy length-matched, distinct controls; it is not a causal effect of task enrichment. No source text is saved.
